Method.name: OnRequest
SyncSSLConfigs
Method.Implementation:
#Dim tBackupMemberList As %ListOfDataTypes
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try { Set tSSLConfigs = ##class(IHC.EAI.Sync.Util).GetSSLConfigs(.tStatus) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tJSON = tSSLConfigs.%ToJSON()
Set tJSONContent = ##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() Set tStatus = tJSONContent.Write(tJSON) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) Do tJSONContent.Rewind()
// Set the location info Set tProperties = "" Set tStatus = ##class(IHC.EAI.Sync.Util).GetBackupMemberInfo(.tBackupMemberList) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
// Loop over backup members, issuing a sync call to each For i=1:1:tBackupMemberList.Count() { Set tBackupMemberItem = tBackupMemberList.GetAt(i) Set tSSLSyncRequest = ##class(IHC.EAI.Sync.REST.Request).%New() Set tSSLSyncRequest.Command = pRequest.Command Set tSSLSyncRequest.SyncType = pRequest.SyncType Set tSSLSyncRequest.JSONContent = tJSONContent
Set tURL = ..#BaseServiceURL Set tURLLastChar = $EXTRACT(tURL,($LENGTH(tURL)-1),$LENGTH(tURL)) Set:(tURLLastChar '= "/") tURL = tURL _ "/"
Set tURL = tURL _ $ZCONVERT(pRequest.SyncType,"L")
Set tSSLSyncRequest.URL = tURL Set tSSLSyncRequest.Server = $PIECE(tBackupMemberItem,"|",1) Set tSSLSyncRequest.Port = $PIECE(tBackupMemberItem,"|",2)
Set tStatus = ..SendRequestSync(..TargetConfigName,pRequest,.pResponse) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus) } } Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus
